adjudication.rationale: The diff makes GoogleCalendarService.createEvent choose the target calendar via `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId`, and then falls back to `calendarId: selectedCalendar || "primary"` (packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts). In EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents, when a destination calendar entry has no `credentialId`, it executes the new else-branch that finds all matching-type credentials and calls `createEvent(c, event)` for each (packages/core/EventManager.ts), without supplying any per-credential externalId and without ensuring any `destinationCalendar` entry matches each credential. Therefore `find(cal.credentialId === credentialId)` will fail for each credential, `selectedCalendar` becomes undefined, and each credential will insert into its "primary" calendar, potentially creating duplicate events on unintended calendars. Also, because CalendarManager.createEvent now returns `externalId` from the third argument, those calls omit it, so the resulting EventResult has `externalId` undefined, and EventManager stores `externalCalendarId: result.externalId` as undefined.
